author: Volodymyr Hryvinskyi
description: Sorting of storefront catalog listings in the search engine: leading sort rules, shopper sort fields and product search document fields contributed by other modules.

author: Volodymyr Hryvinskyi
description: Catalog sort option Best Sellers: the products with the most units ordered in a recent period first, computed by the daily popularity data refresh.

author: Volodymyr Hryvinskyi
description: Catalog sorting capability: per-store product metrics that sort methods define in SQL, refreshed on a schedule and written into the product search documents; only products whose value changed are reindexed.

author: Volodymyr Hryvinskyi
description: Catalog sort option Most Viewed: the products whose page was viewed most in a recent period first, with views counted in the visitor's browser so cached pages count, ranked by the daily popularity data refresh.

author: Volodymyr Hryvinskyi
description: Catalog sort option New: the most recently created products first, ordered by a creation time written into the search documents.

author: Volodymyr Hryvinskyi
description: Catalog sorting rule: products with a listing image before products without one in category listings and, optionally, search results.

author: Volodymyr Hryvinskyi
description: Catalog sort options per store: hide, rename and reorder the options of the storefront Sort By list, and offer the listing sort options other modules register, each opening in its own direction.

author: Volodymyr Hryvinskyi
description: Catalog sorting rule: in-stock products before out-of-stock ones in category listings and search results.

author: Volodymyr Hryvinskyi
description: Catalog sort option Reviews Count: the products with the most customer reviews first, taken from the review summaries by the daily popularity data refresh.

author: Volodymyr Hryvinskyi
description: Catalog sort option Biggest Saving: products with the largest discount from the regular price first, for the shopper's customer group, read from the product price index.

author: Volodymyr Hryvinskyi
description: Catalog sort option Top Rated: the products with the highest customer rating first, taken from the review summaries by the daily popularity data refresh.

author: Volodymyr Hryvinskyi
description: Catalog sort option Now in Wishlists: the products that sit in the most wishlists first, computed by the daily popularity data refresh.

author: Radu Maier
description: A PHP component/library. Logs a user in with Discogs (OAuth 1.0a: request token, authorize URL, access token, identity) and builds the Authorization header of every Discogs API request.

author: Osaris
description: Laravel client for the Discogs API (v2). Authenticated requests only.
